name: Find Text References
description: Find where a domain, script URL, tracking ID or other text appears under a path: inside files (clientlib JavaScript, HTL, CSS, JSON) and in node properties. Use it when full-text search can't see code under /apps. It reads every node under the path, so point it at /apps/<project>, /conf/<site> or a site subtree, not all of /content.

inputs.label: Paths to search — one per line (each produces its own file)
File types to read — one per line (empty = .js .html .css .json .jsp .txt .xml)
